svg.title: So many of our visitors return in Spring.
svg.desc: A reconstruction of the 1984 Tourism B.C. magazine advertisement. Three orcas surface beneath forested mountains. The headline, two columns of copy and Super,Natural British Columbia signature are rebuilt as serif outlines. The photographs are supplied modern recreations. The exact historical typeface remains unconfirmed.
